snippet.title: Cold VR - Official Sub-Zero Edition Update Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the Sub-Zero Edition Update Trailer for Cold VR, a VR time manipulation shooter developed by ALLWARE. Players can now enjoy substantial updates to the core game with the Sub-Zero Edition Update bringing enhanced visuals, new levels, UI overhauls, and more. The Sub-Zero Edition Update for Cold VR is available now for SteamVR and Meta Quest.
